classification.difficultyReason: Use two specified decompositions of the same figure, deriving the missing triangle's base and checking that both methods agree.

content.prompt: Calculate the area of the composite shape by two methods. You should get the same answer.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 8, shared figure on the left
spec.description: Composite region with a sloping left edge, a 13 m horizontal top, a 28 m full base and a 25 m vertical right side. A dashed internal diagonal divides it into a parallelogram and a triangle. The right-hand triangle's base is 15 m. Red dashed completion lines form the enclosing rectangle.
spec.mathematics: Use A=(0,0), B=(28,0), C=(28,25), D=(15,25), E=(13,0), and F=(0,25). AD is parallel to EC; DC is parallel to AE. The included region is ABCD. EBC is the added triangle; AFD is the subtracted triangle. Both triangles have base 15 m and perpendicular height 25 m. The parallelogram AECD has base 13 m and height 25 m.
spec.answerVisibility: All dimensions, parallel marks, the internal division and enclosing-rectangle guides remain visible. No calculated areas appear in the question diagram.

answer.worked:
The missing triangle's base is $28-13=15\text{ m}$.
$$\begin{align*}A_1&=28\times25\\A_1&=700\text{ m}^2\\A_2&=\frac{15\times25}{2}\\A_2&=187.5\text{ m}^2\\A_{\text{Total}}&=A_1-A_2\\A_{\text{Total}}&=700-187.5\\A_{\text{Total}}&=512.5\text{ m}^2\end{align*}$$

$$\begin{align*}A_1&=\frac{15\times25}{2}\\A_1&=187.5\text{ m}^2\\A_2&=13\times25\\A_2&=325\text{ m}^2\\A_{\text{Total}}&=A_1+A_2\\A_{\text{Total}}&=187.5+325\\A_{\text{Total}}&=512.5\text{ m}^2\end{align*}$$
Both methods give $512.5\text{ m}^2$.
